content: {"like": ["The special features section with the twelve‑minute recreation of Welles’s famous Julius Caesar is a marvel, featuring beautiful chiaroscuro and evocative echoes of the era."], "dislike": ["The film itself is not worth watching; it should be skipped in favor of the special features.
